narrative.overview: TrustBazaar is a marketplace for buyers in Bangladesh, in English and Bangla at equal weight. The shipped home page is a bottle-green black ground with white-grey text and a single vermilion that does all the calling. The page proves safety by showing the mechanism (a real listing, a live clock, a "Payment held" card) rather than asserting it with a badge. The system is ruled, not boxed, and that is the heart of the look. Across the user app (home, search, listing page, auction room, header, footer, dialog) there are no filled cards and no outlined or rounded boxes except buttons and images: sections, rows, cells, fields and dialogs are separated by 1px hairlines and dividers, and grids are cells in the page colour over a 1px gap that shows the hairline colour. Depth comes from lines and tone, not shadow. The exception is the home hero, which carries a moving WebGL gradient ground and a frosted-glass product window with a passing sheen; these exist only on the home hero and are not part of the shared system. Colour has jobs. Vermilion is for actions, the live signal, step figures and the one 2px rule that tops a panel asking for an action. Protect Green marks money that is held and sellers that are verified. Pro Gold marks Pro sellers. Error Pink is for errors, being outbid, the last-hour clock and the live dot.
keyCharacteristics: Dark theme on the user app (`data-theme="dark"`); the console, ID check and credentials pages stay on the light tokens.
Ruled Grid: hairlines and cells, no filled cards, no outlined or rounded boxes except buttons and images; radii nearly square (4px images and buttons, 6px the larger buttons).
One vermilion voice; green only for held or verified; gold only for Pro and the rating star.
Schibsted Grotesk 600 for headlines, Figtree for text and every figure.
Hero fills the first screen alone; its moving ground falls back to a still CSS gradient.
44px minimum tap targets; reduced motion switches every animation off.

rules.name: The One Hot Colour Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is the only hot colour. It marks an action, a live signal or a single rule or figure; it is never a large fill and never carries white text.

rules.name: The Protect Green Rule
rules.body: Green means held or verified money and nothing else. Do not use it for "success" decoration or for brand accent. Being outbid is pink, not green.

rules.name: The Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is for Pro and the rating star only; never an action, a fill or a rule.

rules.name: The Ticking Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number, static or ticking (clocks, prices, bids, codes), is Figtree with `tabular-nums`. Schibsted Grotesk sets words, and the step numerals only.

rules.name: The Bangla Face Rule
rules.body: In Bangla the stack becomes `TB Figures, Hind Siliguri, Figtree`, line height 1.7 for body and 1.3 to 1.4 for headings, headings drop to weight 500 with letter-spacing 0. Digits, the taka sign and the separators between them always come from TB Figures so numbers read in one face.

rules.name: The Ruled Grid Rule
rules.body: Lines, not boxes. Separate content with 1px hairlines (`--tb-line`) and ruled cells; do not fill a card, do not outline one with a box. Only buttons and images keep a box. A section, strip, list, field, dialog or code is a rule above it, rules between its cells, and nothing else.

rules.name: The Hot Top Rule
rules.body: A panel that asks the visitor for an action (buy, bid, the bid bar, the room's controls, the confirm dialog) is topped by one 2px vermilion rule on the page or sheet colour. An ended or sold auction loses it and returns to a hairline.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Ring Rule
rules.body: A text field has no box and no ring: it is a 1px control-border line under it, and focus draws a 2px vermilion underline. Buttons and cells take a 2px vermilion focus ring, inset on cells.

rules.name: The Home-Only Glass Rule
rules.body: The WebGL gradient ground (four-colour mesh with grain, pointer-following light, still fallback) and the frosted-glass window with its 7-second sheen exist only on the home hero. New screens do not use backdrop blur, sheen or a moving ground.

dos: **Do** separate sections, rows and cells with 1px hairlines (#2a3b36) and gap-1px grids over the line colour; give only buttons and images a box, at 4px (6px for the larger buttons).
**Do** reserve vermilion (#ff6b35) for actions, live signals, step figures, focus underlines and the single 2px rule atop an action panel, with #0a1018 text on it.
**Do** use Protect Green only for held or verified states, and Pro Gold only for Pro and the rating star.
**Do** set headings in Schibsted Grotesk 600 and every number in Figtree with tabular numerals.
**Do** draw a text field as a line with a vermilion underline on focus.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px minimum and design for 320px, phones under 768, tablets 768 to 1023, laptops 1024 and up.
**Do** keep a still fallback for any animation and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`; give every inset-shadow mark a real border in forced-colours mode.
**Do** keep Bangla on Hind Siliguri with the TB Figures digits first in the stack, at line height 1.7.
donts: **Don't** fill a card, outline a box or round a panel anywhere in the user app; use a rule. Buttons and images are the only boxes.
**Don't** use the WebGL ground, backdrop blur or the glass sheen outside the home hero.
**Don't** put white text on vermilion or use vermilion as a large background fill.
**Don't** put the step numbers in a tile or circle, or turn the language switch, header links or tabs into pills or filled tiles.
**Don't** use Protect Green or Error Pink as decoration, or show green on a buy panel before money is held.
**Don't** add a shadow to a bar, sheet, dialog or cell; shadows belong to the hero and the two floating overlays.
**Don't** set a number in Schibsted Grotesk.
**Don't** convey state by colour alone; the timeline pairs fill with text weight and the clock pairs colour with its label.
